jobs.title: Frontend Software Developer
jobs.description: Mid-level frontend software development role building production-quality web interfaces in Lagos.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; 3–5 years professional software-development experience; strong JavaScript, HTML/CSS and responsive web application skills.
jobs.responsibilities: Build production web interfaces, integrate APIs, debug and test frontend applications, and collaborate with product, design, backend and QA teams.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Developer
jobs.description: Mid-level full-stack software development role covering frontend, backend, APIs, databases and production systems.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; 3–5 years professional software-development experience; production web application experience; frontend, backend, API and database skills.
jobs.responsibilities: Build and maintain production software, develop APIs and services, work with databases, implement application security and resolve production issues.

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description: Mid-level IT support role helping keep people, devices, accounts and internal technology secure and operational.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; 3–5 years IT or systems support experience; practical troubleshooting, networking and endpoint-security knowledge.
jobs.responsibilities: Support users and devices, troubleshoot hardware and software, manage accounts, maintain IT records and assist with security and networking.

jobs.title: Operations Manager, P-3, TA (364 days), #138626
jobs.description: Operations management position with UNICEF Nigeria covering operational management, strategic planning, financial management, supply chain, risk and facilities/ICT management.
jobs.requirements: Advanced university degree or qualifying professional accounting designation; minimum 5 years professional experience in relevant operations-management areas; English fluency.
jobs.responsibilities: Operational management, team leadership, strategic planning, budget and financial management, supply chain, risk, compliance, facilities, ICT and security management.

jobs.title: Senior Geologist
jobs.description: Senior geology role in Aradel Energy's Petroleum Engineering/Subsurface department in Lagos.
jobs.requirements: B.Sc. Geology, Geophysics or related discipline; minimum 12 years progressive oil and gas experience with relevant subsurface geological interpretation and modelling experience.
jobs.responsibilities: Interpret and integrate geological and geophysical data, support drilling and workover activities, build subsurface models, provide technical advice and mentor geologists.
